summary: Backend: 34/34 pytest tests passed covering auth, dashboard/summary, wallet (deposit-address for TRON/BTC/ETH real BIP-44 addresses), withdraw, exchange, invoices, public checkout (select + simulate-pay), contacts, merchant settings + regen, public OKIPAYS API, private OKIPAYS API with valid+invalid signatures + missing token. Frontend: login, dashboard, nav to Wallet/Requests/Contacts/Settings/Docs works; deposit address+QR generated; invoice creation + list works; public checkout page select currency + simulate-pay flow reaches Paid state; Settings shows real merchant token, secret toggle, regen; API Docs renders with real merchant token in curl+python examples; language switcher works. Fixed 2 critical frontend bugs (see updated_files).

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(load, []) where load = () => api.get(...).then(...) returns a Promise -> React runtime error 'destroy is not a function' crashed the page after any state update. FIXED by wrapping: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []).

Route path '/api-docs' starts with '/api' so Kubernetes ingress routed it to backend which returned 404 JSON. The API Docs page was completely unreachable. FIXED by renaming route to '/docs' in App.js and Layout.js. All frontend routes should avoid any path starting with '/api'.

action_items: Confirm the route rename /api-docs -> /docs is acceptable (I updated App.js and Layout.js). Note: ANY frontend route beginning with /api will be swallowed by the ingress; document this rule.
Consider adding an ErrorBoundary around routes for defense-in-depth against similar useEffect/promise bugs.
Blockchain monitoring (Alchemy/TronGrid/Mempool) and 1inch swap keys are empty in .env; deposit detection is only via /checkout/{id}/simulate-pay (documented DEMO mode).
critical_code_review_comments: useEffect(fn, []) pattern is fragile — many pages use `const load = () => api.get(...).then(...)` (implicit Promise return). Prefer `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` project-wide.
server.py is 874 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth_router, cabinet, checkout, public, private).
auth_merchant checks signature only for POST; consider requiring it for GET too if intended by OKIPAYS spec (currently GET /private/coins is token-only which matches the request).
CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] would be invalid but code correctly narrows to FRONTEND_URL when set. Good.
seed_demo re-hashes admin password on every startup if env password changes — good, but note it also runs on every startup even when data exists (idempotent OK).
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ (invoices, contacts) created via API; not cleaned up (small volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend fixes applied for 3 critical bugs. If retesting, verify /docs route works (was /api-docs). Real HD addresses: USDT/TRX -> starts with 'T', BTC -> 'bc1' or '1'/'3', EVM -> '0x'. Private API signature: sort keys recursively, concat values, append secret, sha256 hex.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1: `useEffect(load, [])` with load returning a Promise chain — React interprets the returned Promise as the cleanup function and later tries to invoke it, throwing 'destroy is not a function'. Reproduction: any state update on Requests page after mount. Mitigation: wrap load() invocation in a plain arrow function inside useEffect. Bug 2: Kubernetes ingress rule routes any path starting with '/api' to the backend (port 8001). The frontend SPA route '/api-docs' collides with this prefix, so the browser receives FastAPI's 404 JSON instead of index.html. Mitigation: rename SPA route to avoid the '/api' prefix (used '/docs').
